description: Melee support - stands in the scrum with a shield while buffing the party off its own attack power, and uniquely scales off Spirit.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_guardian__inspiration.txt: 'Closest to Augmentation Evoker ... an Augmentation Evoker that decided to also gear like a Protection Warrior.' The unusual thing about this spec, and the reason for the Spirit nodes, is CoA's stat priority: Hit > Expertise > Strength > SPIRIT > Crit > Haste > Stamina. Spirit 'uniquely powers' its Decrees, its Feats and Song of Steel.

nodes.name: Powerful Voice
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA stat priority: 'Critical Strike (Tempo/Powerful Voice stacking)'.

nodes.name: Minstrel
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Minstrel's stacking haste builds as you cast Ballads'.

nodes.name: Field Training
nodes.description: Increases your Strength by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA stat priority leads with Strength for 'Ballad/Sunder/Song of Battle weapon-damage scaling'.

nodes.name: Devotion
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Spirit (uniquely powers Soldier's/Spellcaster's/Hero's Decrees, Feats of Strength/Honor/Glory, and Song of Steel)'. No other melee spec in the game wants Spirit; this node is the reason it does.

nodes.name: Tempo
nodes.description: Your Ballads build toward something. Each one increases your damage by 3% per rank for a short time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'chasing the 3-stack Tempo proc', 'builds Tempo toward a free Sound of War'.

nodes.name: Inspiring Leader
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Broad Sweep by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Inspiring Leader also turns it into a Ballad'.

nodes.name: Sound of War
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ballad of Steel by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'builds Tempo toward a free Sound of War'.

nodes.name: Feats of Strength
nodes.description: Grants attack power equal to 3% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Feats of Strength/Honor/Glory' are Spirit-powered. A real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion - resolved against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py.

nodes.name: Veteran of the Third War
nodes.description: Blows you block knit you back together.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Use Veteran of the Third War's on-block heal and Fearless while surrounded'. The spec's only sustain.

nodes.name: Stand Your Ground!
nodes.description: Your Standard of Valiance reduces allies' physical damage taken by a further 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Stand Your Ground! reduces allies' physical damage taken while they stand in it'.

nodes.name: Broad Shoulders
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 3% and Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Inspiration is literally standing in melee with a shield and a block-rating stat' - it needs real armour to survive where it fights.

nodes.name: Hero of the People
nodes.description: Increases the healing you do by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: Scales Veteran of the Third War and the class heals; CoA is explicit that this spec's 'primary value is buffing an ally's damage output rather than direct healing', so this is deliberately small.

nodes.name: Shield of the Standard
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: The 'block-rating stat' CoA says this spec gears for.

nodes.name: You Shall Not Fall!
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns against you and your allies by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'You Shall Not Fall! gives them stun and grip resistance'.

nodes.name: Warsong
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: Song of Steel and Inspiring Presence both scale off the Guardian's own attack power, so a point here buffs the whole party.

nodes.name: Feats of Glory
nodes.description: Grants healing power equal to 3% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: The healing member of the Spirit-powered Feats trio.

nodes.name: Champion of the Line
nodes.description: Your party buffs last 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: Uptime on the Augmentation half of the kit.

nodes.name: Harrowing Refrain
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Both keep personal DPS uptime while doing it'.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Chorus
nodes.description: Reduces damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: Survival for a support that fights in melee range.

nodes.name: Song of the Fallen
nodes.description: Increases the attack power your songs grant allies by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: The party-facing payoff node.

nodes.name: Perfect Pitch
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: Pairs with Powerful Voice and Tempo.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 8% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Outside Voidborne you are thin' is the Godblade problem, and this spec has the same shape - thin when the buffs are down.

nodes.name: Anthem of the Vanguard
nodes.description: For a few turns nobody in earshot misses, falters, or falls behind.
nodes._source: Capstone. The Ebon-Might-style group window CoA's Augmentation Evoker comparison points at.
